dates.label: First day of mailing Vote by Mail ballots
dates.detail: Every registered voter in Alameda County is mailed a ballot (29 days before Election Day). Return envelope is postage-paid and must be signed.
dates.label_es: Primer día de envío de boletas por correo
dates.detail_es: A cada votante registrado del Condado de Alameda se le envía una boleta (29 días antes del Día de la Elección). El sobre de devolución tiene franqueo pagado y debe estar firmado.

dates.label: Early voting begins at the Registrar of Voters office; 24-hour drop boxes open
dates.detail: ROV office (1225 Fallon St): weekdays from Oct 5, 8:30 a.m.-5:00 p.m.; Sat Oct 31 and Sun Nov 1, 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m.; Election Day 7:00 a.m.-8:00 p.m. 66 official 24-hour drop boxes open Oct 5 until 8:00 p.m. on Nov 3.
dates.label_es: Comienza la votación anticipada en la oficina del Registro de Votantes; abren los buzones oficiales de 24 horas
dates.detail_es: Oficina del Registro de Votantes (ROV) (1225 Fallon St): días de semana a partir del 5 de oct., 8:30 a.m.-5:00 p.m.; sáb. 31 de oct. y dom. 1 de nov., 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m.; Día de la Elección 7:00 a.m.-8:00 p.m. 66 buzones oficiales de 24 horas abiertos desde el 5 de oct. hasta las 8:00 p.m. del 3 de nov.

dates.label: Ballot Drop Stop tour begins (through Oct 30)
dates.detail: From Oct 30 through Nov 3 the Ballot Drop Stop is at 1225 Fallon St., Oakland. Tour stops listed at acvote.alamedacountyca.gov/dropstop (loaded dynamically).
dates.label_es: Comienza la gira Ballot Drop Stop (hasta el 30 de oct.)
dates.detail_es: Del 30 de oct. al 3 de nov., el Ballot Drop Stop está en 1225 Fallon St., Oakland. Las paradas de la gira aparecen en acvote.alamedacountyca.gov/dropstop (se carga dinámicamente).

dates.label: Start of Vote by Mail processing
dates.detail: County Election Information page; toolkit p.8.
dates.label_es: Inicio del procesamiento de boletas por correo
dates.detail_es: Página de Información Electoral del condado; kit de herramientas p.8.

dates.label: Close of voter registration (15 days before election)
dates.detail: Register online at registertovote.ca.gov or by paper form; voters who register after this date may need to vote at a Vote Center.
dates.label_es: Cierre del registro de votantes (15 días antes de la elección)
dates.detail_es: Regístrese en línea en registertovote.ca.gov o con el formulario en papel; los votantes que se registren después de esta fecha podrían tener que votar en un centro de votación.

dates.label: Conditional (same-day) voter registration available after the registration deadline
dates.detail: County says eligible voters can conditionally register and vote at any Alameda County Vote Center after the Oct 19 deadline (through Election Day). Exact start day is not printed; date shown is the deadline after which it applies.
dates.label_es: Registro condicional de votantes (el mismo día) disponible después de la fecha límite de registro
dates.detail_es: El condado indica que los votantes elegibles pueden registrarse condicionalmente y votar en cualquier centro de votación del Condado de Alameda después de la fecha límite del 19 de oct. (hasta el Día de la Elección). El día exacto de inicio no está impreso; la fecha mostrada es la fecha límite después de la cual aplica.

dates.label: Public Logic and Accuracy Testing
dates.detail: County Election Information page, Important Dates.
dates.label_es: Prueba pública de lógica y precisión
dates.detail_es: Página de Información Electoral del condado, Fechas Importantes.

dates.label: First 20 Vote Centers open (county labels these "10-Day Vote Centers"; county pages elsewhere say 11 days)
dates.detail: 20 Vote Centers open Sat Oct 24-Mon Nov 2, 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m., and Election Day Nov 3, 7:00 a.m.-8:00 p.m. Any voter may use any Vote Center.
dates.label_es: Abren los primeros 20 centros de votación (el condado los denomina "10-Day Vote Centers"; otras páginas del condado dicen 11 días)
dates.detail_es: 20 centros de votación abren del sáb. 24 de oct. al lun. 2 de nov., 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m., y el Día de la Elección, 3 de nov., 7:00 a.m.-8:00 p.m. Cualquier votante puede usar cualquier centro de votación.

dates.label: Last day to request a replacement Vote by Mail ballot (to be mailed); also the county's recommended last day to mail a ballot
dates.detail: Request via (510) 272-6973 or the online form. VIG p.2 advises mailing the ballot by Oct 27 so it is received in time to be processed.
dates.label_es: Último día para solicitar una boleta por correo de reemplazo (para que se envíe por correo); también es el último día que el condado recomienda para enviar una boleta por correo
dates.detail_es: Solicítela al (510) 272-6973 o mediante el formulario en línea. La Guía de Información para el Votante (VIG), p.2, aconseja enviar la boleta por correo a más tardar el 27 de oct. para que se reciba a tiempo para ser procesada.

dates.label: 80 additional Vote Centers open ("4-Day Vote Centers"; 100 total)
dates.detail: Open Sat Oct 31-Mon Nov 2, 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m., and Election Day 7:00 a.m.-8:00 p.m.
dates.label_es: Abren 80 centros de votación adicionales ("4-Day Vote Centers"; 100 en total)
dates.detail_es: Abiertos del sáb. 31 de oct. al lun. 2 de nov., 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m., y el Día de la Elección 7:00 a.m.-8:00 p.m.

dates.label: Election Day
dates.detail: All Vote Centers open 7:00 a.m.-8:00 p.m.; 24-hour drop boxes close at 8:00 p.m.; results posted shortly after 8:00 p.m.
dates.detail_es: Todos los centros de votación abren 7:00 a.m.-8:00 p.m.; los buzones oficiales de 24 horas cierran a las 8:00 p.m.; los resultados se publican poco después de las 8:00 p.m.

dates.label: Deadline for mailed ballots to arrive (must be postmarked on or before Nov 3)
dates.detail: Ballots returned in person must be received by 8:00 p.m. on Election Day.
dates.label_es: Fecha límite para que lleguen las boletas enviadas por correo (deben tener sello postal del 3 de nov. o antes)
dates.detail_es: Las boletas entregadas en persona deben recibirse a más tardar a las 8:00 p.m. del Día de la Elección.

dates.label: Random selection of batches for the 1% manual tally
dates.label_es: Selección aleatoria de lotes para el conteo manual del 1%
dates.detail_es: Página de Información Electoral del condado.

gaps: Statewide propositions are on the ballot (the county VIG sample ballot shows them) but were not extracted, per instructions. They are in the State Voter Information Guide (voterguide.sos.ca.gov).

Judicial retention contests (California Supreme Court and First District Court of Appeal justices; e.g., Justice Joshua Groban) appear on the county sample ballot in the VIG but are not on the county Candidate List, so they were not extracted. They are in the obfuscated-font sample ballot pages of the VIG PDF (pdf pages ~40 onward).

No Alameda County offices (Board of Supervisors, DA, Sheriff, Assessor, County Superintendent of Schools, Superior Court) are on the Nov 3 list: the county candidate list for election 260 has only Federal, State, School Districts, Special Districts and City categories, while the June 2 primary list (election 259) had County, Supervisor and Superior Court categories. So there are no county runoffs on this ballot. (Inference from category lists; the county does not state it.)
Term lengths are not printed in the county list except "Short Term" / "Full Term" in some titles; `term` is null elsewhere (not filled from outside knowledge).

The county list's Incumbent flag is unreliable (31 "Y" vs 235 "N"; several sitting officeholders, e.g., Rep. Lateefah Simon, Rep. Mark DeSaulnier, Mayor Barbara Lee, are flagged "N"). `incumbent` is true only where the list says Y and null otherwise; the raw flag is in `incumbent_listed`. Ballot designations such as "Incumbent" appear verbatim in `ballot_designation`.
30 races are marked "Not On Ballot" on the county list (35 Filing-Completed candidates) and are in `not_on_ballot_contests`, not `contests`. The county does not state the reason.

Peralta Community College District Trustee, Area 1, Short Term is listed by the county as an office on the ballot, but the candidate list returns no candidate rows for it (no seats/vote-for value either).

10 filings on the county list are not "Filing Completed" and are excluded from candidates: 5 in on-ballot contests (Candidacy Withdrawn: Kate Runyon, Linda Hurley; Incomplete Filing: Mark Williams, Heriberto Perez, Shanavaz Nasarabadi) kept under `not_qualified_filings`, and 5 in not-on-ballot contests (Mike McMahon withdrawn; Tonya Arledge, Barbara Armstrong, Jonathan Leder, Jason Matthew Miguel incomplete). None of the five on-ballot ones appears on the VIG sample ballot.

County measures list prints "Percentage Passing: N/A" for Measures RTM, J, K, BB. Thresholds for these were filled from the county VIG (RTM majority district-wide, J two-thirds, K 55 percent, BB majority) and flagged with `threshold_src`.

Registrar phone is inconsistent across county pages: (510) 272-6973 (site footer, VIG help line) vs (510) 272-6933 (About Us page, VIG letterhead and Measure J analysis); toolkit FAQ lists (510) 272-6982, which the footer gives as the fax number. Both 6973 and 6933 are recorded.

Per-address sample ballots are only available through the voter-login Voter Profile; the composite VIG PDF is the public sample. Vote center list was pulled from the county list fragment (100 centers); the drop-box map is JavaScript/Google Maps and its page text is a stale 2020 copy, so the 66 drop boxes were taken from VIG pages 9-11. Dropbox/vote-center lists are marked "subject to change" by the county.
Ballot Drop Stop tour dates/locations load dynamically and were not retrieved.
Candidate statements were not extracted; they are Tab 4 of the VIG PDF (pages after the sample ballots, roughly pdf pp. 300-750).

San Leandro RCV status is ambiguous: county RCV page lists San Leandro among RCV cities, but the Nov 3 2026 sample ballot shows San Leandro contests as standard contests. `rcv` is null for San Leandro contests.

Source-data quirks: Albany Council candidate Aaron Tiedemann has Filing Agency "City of Alameda"; Measure L question text has an encoding artifact (normalized to an em dash); the county lists the same person in several contests (Joseph Grcar 6 contests, Luis Reynoso 3, Joe Orlando Ramos 2).
